auto_instrumentation.goal: zero-code tracing; no application-level imports, annotations or wrappers needed

mechanisms.compiler: typed HIR/MIR instrumentation of selected callable bodies and async state machine exits

build.trace_capable: compile fixed low-cardinality boundaries; emit optional callable probes only if selected by build profile; all tracing disabled at runtime until explicit opt-in
build.trace_stripped: elide optional probes entirely; cannot turn on missing call-site coverage without rebuilding

options.scopes: compile-time include/exclude stable fully qualified symbols; use snake_case and avoid dynamic user strings
options.precedence: build-time coverage is an upper bound; runtime can enable a subset but cannot add missing probes

runtime.sampling: parent-based deterministic root sampling, bounded for traces and spans; sampled=false context remains propagate-able when explicitly authorized
runtime.config: operator CLI or package config; no application source edits
runtime.backpressure: drop eligible telemetry, increment bounded drop counters, never block actor execution

configuration.environment_cannot_grant: network/filesystem/trace-export capabilities and cross-tenant context propagation
configuration.otel_disabled_semantics: OTEL_SDK_DISABLED disables recording and export; any explicit propagation policy remains independent as specified by OTEL_PROPAGATORS
configuration.attributes: allowlisted semantic attributes; bounded key/value sizes and cardinality

probe_abi.purpose: compiler intrinsic/runtime internal only, not a callable userland hook interface
probe_abi.recording: disabled guard and sampler must run before timestamp or expensive argument construction
probe_abi.storage: preallocated bounded actor/scheduler shards or nonblocking collector try_send; no guest object references
probe_abi.site_id: stable compiler-defined numeric canonical symbol/operation identity; disambiguated independently of source line offsets
probe_abi.error_handling: telemetry failure never replaces guest error, modifies authorization, or suppresses supervisor CONTROL notice
probe_abi.lifecycle: exactly once completed spans where execution unwinds normally, including cancel/recover; fatal process abort may only preserve bounded crash-safe data opportunistically
probe_abi.async: trace context attached to owned continuation and message envelope; not OS/JVM thread local
probe_abi.deduplication: one semantic HTTP/DB operation span; optional lower-level TCP events are children/metrics and must not duplicate operation spans
probe_abi.host_boundary: separate runtime-internal diagnostic events from optional exported application-safe spans

propagation.default_off: do not capture, export or automatically forward untrusted context unless propagation explicitly permitted
propagation.enabled_unsampled: preserve immutable valid W3C parent context even for nonrecording spans, without allocating local span events
propagation.carrier: logical task, continuation, channel envelope or actor-mail metadata; no pointers or mutable guest span transfer
propagation.messaging: producer and consumer spans plus links when topology is fan-out/batch; single-parent rules otherwise
propagation.security: strict W3C parsing, baggage allowlist, quotas, actor incarnation/generation and tenant trust checks
propagation.restart: revoked generation cannot revive context on late callback
